parts.resolution: ST DS12022 Rev 7: pin 1 GND, pin 2/tab OUT, pin 3 IN; same native SOT-223 lands. 4.75-5.25 V input exceeds 3.3 V plus 0.6 V maximum dropout. Retain C40 10 uF input and C42 22 uF X5R 25 V output; verify effective output capacitance >=4.7 uF at voltage/temperature. Full-temperature +/-3% accuracy plus 15 mV load and line regulation fits the modeled 3.18-3.42 V rail. Noise is 60 uVrms/Vout (198 uVrms at 3.3 V), typical 10 Hz-100 kHz; not 60 uVrms total. ADC analog RC filtering and physical noise qualification remain required.
